Ukraine Strikes Kerch Bridge Linking Russia and Crimea

Ukraine launched an aerial attack using drones and missiles that damaged the Kerch Bridge, also known as the Crimea Bridge, which connects Russia to occupied Crimea. Traffic on the bridge was halted following the strike. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky described the attack as 'unprecedented.' Russia stated that the aerial attack involved more than 1,300 drones.
